data.other_hard: international student; meet the general and country specific eligibility criteria as listed in the Australia Awards Scholarship Handbook
data.evidence_sentence: Students from eligible developing countries are given the opportunity to undertake full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study, research and professional development in Australia.
data.notes: RMIT university page for the DFAT-funded Australia Awards Scholarships. Eligibility requires citizenship of any participating country, but the country list is only on the external Handbook/website and is not in the text, so nationality is treated as REGION. Priority areas of study are mentioned but not listed. Value varies by country of origin; full tuition and living contribution are listed as generally applying. Deadline is month only (April 2027). No minimum GPA stated.
